features.name: Foundation: Martial Form
features.description: Take the Martial Form sheet. You start with two martial stances from Tier 1. When you reach a new tier, take two additional stances at your tier or lower.

features.name: Foundation: Focus
features.description: During a rest, roll a number of d6s equal to your Instinct and place a number of Focus tokens equal to the highest value rolled on this card. Spend a Focus to shift into a stance until you take Severe damage, the scene ends, you mark your last Hit Point, or you shift into another stance.

features.name: Specialization: Keen Defenses
features.description: When you are targeted by an attack, you can spend a Focus to give the attack roll disadvantage.

features.name: Specialization: Spirit Blast
features.description: Spend a Focus to make an Instinct Roll against an adversary within Close range. On a success, deal d20+3 magic damage using your Proficiency, and you can spend an additional Focus to make them temporarily Vulnerable.

features.name: Mastery: Limit Breaker
features.description: Once per rest, you can perform an unbelievable feat such as running across water, leaping between distant rooftops, or scaling the side of a building without needing to roll. When you do, gain a Hope and clear a Stress.
